title: Fold scalar JSON string arrays into parent nodes instead of minting standalone tag nodes

sections.what: Stop indexing JSON scalar string arrays (tags, files, links.wiki) as standalone tag nodes; fold them into the parent JSON record or section words and docstring.
sections.why: On viwo, 283,900 of 557,944 nodes (51%) are standalone tag nodes from JSON arrays, bloating the index and letting 1-line array items steal top-5 RRF slots.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_codesearch_parsers.py and verify node counts + search results on sample JSON tasks.

acceptance.text: Scalar string arrays in JSON files are folded into parent record/section words and docstring instead of creating standalone tag nodes.
Existing JSON parser tests updated and passing, confirming tag/array content remains FTS-searchable without top-5 RRF tag-node pollution.

evidence: Updated _walk_list in src/codesearch/parsers/json_parser.py to fold scalar non-prose JSON arrays into the parent record node instead of minting standalone tag nodes.
Updated tests/test_codesearch_parsers.py and verified with `pytest tests/test_codesearch_parsers.py` (26 passed).
